profile.headline: Software Engineer @ GitHub
profile.summary: Software Engineer at GitHub -- working on the Repos platform team.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Teaching kids of various ages how to program. From 5-6yo students learning Scratch, to high
school students learning Python, Java, and Web Development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop and enhance an application tailored to collaboration and music production. Work with a team and utilize various technologies to develop the application from scratch (ReactJS, FastAPI,Pyo)

positions.title: Crew
positions.description: Working as a crew member on the line and front-of-house. Serving food and keeping restaurant up to standards while maintaining and healthy and clean environment.

positions.title: Student Community Manager
positions.description: Demonstrates problem-solving, leadership, and organization as the first point of contact for the CEL team. Handling scheduling, weekly staff meetings, end of semester evaluations, budgeting, and more. The first point of contact while on-call during emergencies and critical situations at Bear Creek Apartments.

positions.title: Community Engagement Leader
positions.description: Primary source of emergency response at Bear Creek Apartments, utilizing multiple data tracking tools to encode access cards while adhering to government law regarding FERPA. Along with event planning and community outreach catering to CU Boulder’s student population.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: With the executive high school internship, I gained experience in the veterinary field with a lot of hands-on experience.  I had the chance to work with technicians and veterinarians during surgeries, and I got the chance to learn a lot about the field itself. I helped around the hospital with restraint, nail trims, and multiple other tasks. I learned how to use a lot of the equipment, as well as identify medicines. I also gained experience in the working world, learning how to communicate and take on responsability.
